verdict_line: Claim 2 — false: `RetryingSender.send` throws `Error('attachments not supported by RetryingSender')` for any message with attachments (src/retrying-sender.ts:10-12), directly violating the `Sender` contract in src/sender.ts:4-6 ("must never throw for a valid Message ... including messages with attachments"), so it cannot safely replace `EmailSender` everywhere.
